svg.title: Frozen evidence, validation selection, and artifact lineage
svg.desc: Two-panel methodology diagram. The left panel records frozen source pins and raw versus analyzed split sizes. The right panel shows validation-only selection from a ten-run matrix, then production of a checkpoint and an empirical percentile lookup sourced from six thousand output-length labels. Held-out Kendall tau is evaluation only.
